name: noteflare
description: Keep your notes on Cloudflare. Keep them to yourself. Google Keep–style notes with end-to-end encryption on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.test:critical: vitest run tests/crypto.test.ts tests/sync.test.ts tests/merge.test.ts tests/auth.test.ts tests/setup.test.ts tests/tokens.test.ts tests/passkeys.test.ts tests/shares.test.ts tests/backups.test.ts tests/export.test.ts tests/attachments.test.ts tests/selfUpdate.test.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler deploy && bun run db:migrate:remote

DB.description: D1 database that stores encrypted notes. Created automatically.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Keep todo. On first open, NoteFlare sets up the Cloudflare Access login for you. Only for a manual setup: your Zero Trust team domain, e.g. https://myteam.cloudflareaccess.com.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Your email address. Only these emails (or @domain, comma-separated) may use NoteFlare; the first-run setup also allows them in the Cloudflare login.

UPDATE_CHECK_REPO.description: GitHub repository checked for new NoteFlare releases (owner/repo). Set it to your fork, or to off to disable the check.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Keep todo. NoteFlare fills it in during its first-run setup. Only for a manual setup: the AUD tag of your Access application.
